response.justification: While the candidate possesses extensive staff-level software engineering experience, strong engineering practices, and recent, highly relevant exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol, they do not meet the minimum requirement of 8+ years building and shipping production-grade AI solutions. Significant gaps also exist in their stated experience with key AI technologies such as Python, vector databases, and RAG architectures, which are critical for this Staff Forward Deployed Engineer role.
strengths: Recent, highly relevant experience with AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
Extensive staff-level software engineering experience with strong engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD).
Proven technical leadership, mentoring, and full-stack development capabilities.
concerns: Does not meet the minimum 8 years of experience building and shipping production-grade AI solutions.
Lacks explicit experience with Python, vector databases, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
Limited demonstrated experience designing and building AI systems on major cloud platforms over a sustained period.
